entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Once again, I've learned something new[n]about you today.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: As allies fighting alongside one another,[n]your strength is truly reassuring.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: In all honesty, it's to the point that[n]I'd be relying on you in a pinch.
I'd say the same for you.
The feeling's mutual.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Is that so? Well, that would please me[n]greatly.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Haha, you truly are well-composed.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm sorry I asked you to indulge me,[n]but I do feel a bit better now.
I feel like my bond with[n]Akechi is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: By the way, about that duel—if we had[n]fought to the end, do you see yourself[n]winning?
I definitely wouldn't lose.[clr 27]
I don't know.
Probably.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I had a feeling you'd say that.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So it would've been a possibility...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...I see. You're quite confident.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm going to be entirely honest with you:[n]I hate you.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Your deft handling of your unfortunate[n]circumstances, your uniqueness, your[n]ability to surpass me—all these irritate me.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...You're the one person I refuse to lose to.
Same here.
Really hate losing, don't you?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You really are— No, never mind.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Without a doubt. Even I was unaware[n]that it was this severe.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll let you have this win today—but[n]next time, I will be victorious.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Let this be my proof.
This is one of the gloves[n]Akechi usually wears...
This glove proves what, exactly?
What do you mean by "proof"?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: There's a tradition in the West to throw[n]one's glove at their opponent when[n]demanding a duel.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Should the opponent accept the glove,[n]the duel is also accepted.
I accept.
Let me think about it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Make certain that you never forget:[n]I am the one who will defeat you.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ah, look at the time. Let's call it a day[n]for now.
